exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.precautions: Entire lower back gently pressed into floor - no gap;Only opposite arm+leg move - torso completely still;Move very slowly - 3 seconds out, 3 back;Breathe out slowly as you reach
exercises.cues: Low back gently pressed to floor;Move opposite arm and leg slowly;Breathe out as you reach

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.precautions: Body one straight line - hips not sagging or high;Elbows under shoulders, forearms flat;Squeeze glutes and thighs hard the whole time;Head neutral - look at floor, breathe steadily
exercises.cues: Body in one straight line;Squeeze glutes and core;Breathe steadily, hips level

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.precautions: Kneel tall facing cable, hips stay back and still;Rope by your ears - arms locked, they never pull;Curl ribs toward pelvis - spine rounds like a C;Lower back stays put - only your torso curls
exercises.cues: Kneel, rope behind head;Curl down ribs-to-pelvis;Rise slowly to tall kneeling

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.precautions: Sit tall, knees bent, heels lightly on floor;Lean back slightly with a LONG straight back - never rounded;Rotate from ribs - shoulders turn, hips stay still;Move slowly - momentum does no work here
exercises.cues: Sit tall, lean back a little;Turn shoulders side to side;Tap floor lightly each side

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.precautions: Plank position - body one straight line head-to-heels;Hands directly under shoulders, arms straight;Hips stay level - no bouncing up and down;Knees drive toward chest, feet land softly
exercises.cues: Start in strong plank;Drive knees in alternately;Keep hips low and steady
